# crypto_jwks (Resource)

JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) as a resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crypto_jwks" "example" {
  keys = [
    {
      private_key       = file("${path.module}/ec-key.pem")
      certificate       = file("${path.module}/ec-cert.pem")
      certificate_chain = []
      key_id            = "ec-signing-key"
      algorithm         = "ES256"
      use               = "sig"
    },
    {
      private_key       = file("${path.module}/rsa-key.pem")
      certificate       = file("${path.module}/rsa-cert.pem")
      certificate_chain = []
      key_id            = "rsa-encryption-key"
      algorithm         = "RS256"
      use               = "enc"
    }
  ]
}

output "jwks_content" {
  value     = crypto_jwks.example.jwks
  sensitive = true
}

# Example with base JWKS
resource "crypto_jwks" "with_base" {
  base_jwks = file("${path.module}/base-jwks.json")

  keys = [
    {
      private_key = file("${path.module}/new-key.pem")
      key_id      = "new-key"
      algorithm   = "ES256"
      use         = "sig"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_jwks` (String, Sensitive) Optional base JWKS JSON content to use as the initial key set
- `keys` (Attributes List) List of keys to include in the JWKS (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `jwks` (String, Sensitive) JSON Web Key Set content

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Required:

- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded private key (RSA or EC)

Optional:

- `algorithm` (String) Algorithm intended for use with this key (e.g., RS256, ES256)
- `certificate` (String) PEM-encoded certificate
- `certificate_chain` (List of String) List of PEM-encoded certificates forming the certificate chain
- `key_id` (String) Key ID (kid) for this key. If not provided, a random ID will be generated
- `use` (String) Public key use parameter (sig or enc)
